# SPORTENVO Off-Site Authority & Editorial Outreach Plan

Updated: 2026-09-26

## Goal

Build third-party references that connect SPORTENVO with commercial padel court systems, foundation planning, roof systems, high-wind engineering, mobile / relocatable courts and project delivery.

Do not pursue bulk directory links, paid link farms, PBNs, or generic press-release syndication. Prioritize editorially relevant mentions, expert contributions, project case studies and interviews.

## Canonical brand identity

- Brand: SPORTENVO
- Entity description: Commercial Padel Court Systems & Project Solutions
- Business role: Manufacturer + Project Support
- Website: https://sportenvo.com/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@sportenvopadel
- Email: sales@sportenvo.com
- Core audiences: clubs, resorts, sports facilities, developers, contractors, distributors

## Priority editorial targets

### 1. Padel Business Magazine

Editorial fit: B2B padel industry, club owners, operators, investors and decision-makers.

Pitch angle:
**Concrete vs Modular: What Commercial Padel Buyers Should Know Before Choosing a Foundation**

Key points:
- Foundation is a project decision, not a product accessory.
- Compare ground, drainage, anchoring, loads, wind and long-term site use.
- Modular foundation does not mean zero site preparation.
- Include real project context without presenting the article as an advert.

Suggested source page:
https://sportenvo.com/modular-foundation-guide.html

Secondary angle:
**Fixed vs Retractable Padel Roofs: Five Interfaces Clubs Should Resolve Before Ordering**
Source:
https://sportenvo.com/padel-court-roof-guide.html

## Editorial email templates

### Padel Business Magazine

Subject: Expert contribution idea — commercial padel foundations: concrete vs modular

Hello Padel Business Magazine editorial team,

I’m reaching out from SPORTENVO, a commercial padel court systems manufacturer supporting international club, resort and sports-facility projects.

We would like to contribute a practical, non-promotional article for commercial padel buyers:

**Concrete vs Modular: What Commercial Padel Buyers Should Know Before Choosing a Foundation**

The article would focus on the decisions operators and developers need to resolve before specification — ground conditions, drainage, anchoring, loads, wind exposure, permanent civil works, relocation requirements and responsibility boundaries.

We can support the piece with technical diagrams, real project context and field photos, while keeping the article educational rather than product-led.

Reference:
https://sportenvo.com/modular-foundation-guide.html

If this topic fits your editorial calendar, we can send a concise outline or a complete draft for review.

Best regards,
SPORTENVO
sales@sportenvo.com
